hook.text: A coal mine worth $2 billion becomes worthless overnight when the government bans coal power generation.

buildup.text: Stranded assets are investments that lose value prematurely due to regulation, technology change, or market shifts.

discovery.text: Carbon Tracker estimates $1 trillion in fossil fuel assets could be stranded as the world shifts to clean energy.

twist.text: Oil companies still invest billions in new reserves that may never be burned under net-zero commitments.

climax.text: Stranded asset risk isn't theoretical. It's happening now in coal, and oil and gas are next in line.

punchline.text: $2 billion mine. One regulation. Worthless overnight.

quiz.question: What is a stranded asset?
options: An investment that loses value prematurely due to external changes
An asset located in a remote area
